description: The agent must: 1) Read the SKILL.md to discover the proprietary '品牌命名方案' template format. 2) Generate a file named 'brand_naming_report.md' with the exact top-level header '# 品牌命名方案'. 3) Include a '## 备选名称' section with at least 3 proposals, each using '### 方案N' headers and containing all 7 required fields: 读音, 含义, 联想, 优点, 缺点, 域名 (with ✓/✗ symbols and .com/.cn/.com.cn checked), and 商标 (with □可注册/□有风险 notation). 4) Include a '## 名称评估' section with a table using ★ star symbols covering at least 4 of the 5 required dimensions (好记程度, 行业相关性, 国际化, 可注册性, 总体评分) plus numeric scores. 5) Include a '## 推荐方案' section with the recommended name in **bold**. 6) Use motor-industry relevant naming vocabulary from the 电机相关命名参考 section. 7) Avoid any names from the 命名禁区 list. The key traps are: the exact ★ symbol format, the □可注册/□有风险 trademark notation, the ✓/✗ domain symbols, all three domain extensions, and all 7 per-proposal fields.
